note: Certification status is per method. 'level2' means ASNT NDT Level II certified. 'supported' means documented and supported in the current Technical Assistant role, not personally certified.

methods.name: Visual Testing
methods.desc: Direct and remote examination of surfaces and welds for discontinuities visible to the eye.

methods.name: Liquid Penetrant
methods.desc: Capillary action draws penetrant into surface-breaking defects, revealed by developer.

methods.name: Magnetic Particle
methods.desc: Flux leakage at surface and near-surface flaws gathers magnetic particles into an indication.

methods.name: Ultrasonic Testing
methods.desc: High-frequency sound reflects from internal discontinuities and the back wall.

methods.name: Radiographic Testing
methods.desc: Radiation records internal weld structure onto film or a digital detector.
methods.note: Also certified in RTFI, radiographic film interpretation.

methods.name: Phased Array UT
methods.desc: A multi-element probe steers the beam electronically to sweep the weld volume.

methods.name: Post Weld Heat Treatment
methods.desc: Controlled heating and cooling relieves residual stress introduced by welding.

methods.name: Hardness Testing
methods.desc: Indentation resistance verifies material condition and heat-treatment result.

methods.name: Positive Material ID
methods.desc: Alloy composition confirmed on site against the specified material grade.

methods.name: Ferrite Testing
methods.desc: Ferrite content measured in austenitic and duplex stainless steel welds.
